subject.title: feat(mac): Quick Chat v2 — enable toggle, agent switching, zoom entrance, window screenshots

question: May agent switching ship while Command-Return under global scope opens the shared global session without preserving the selected agent?
rationale: The implementation intentionally accepts a session-context mismatch that can confuse users after sending to a non-default agent, so repository product intent is required before landing it.

options.title: Preserve the selected agent
options.body: Thread the selected agent identifier through full-chat navigation before merging so the opened conversation matches the accepted send route.

options.title: Accept the limitation temporarily
options.body: Land with the mismatch explicitly documented and a concrete canonical follow-up owned for the navigation contract.

recommendation.title: Preserve the selected agent
recommendation.body: Thread the selected agent identifier through full-chat navigation before merging so the opened conversation matches the accepted send route.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the merged Quick Chat behavior and owns the current routing and navigation follow-up.
